ohc: Avinu met bammidbar. taam amro met bammidbar, lishlol shello met bemitzrayim, vehakkavvana baze ben leman deamar nitchalleka levae haaretz ben leman deamar nitchalleka leyotze mitzrayim zo hi ikkar taanatam, leman deamar leyotze mitzrayim amru met bammidbar hare shehaya miyyotze mitzrayim, vedikdeku gam ken betevat bammidbar lomar shehaya mikkelal otam shennigzera alehem gezerat "bammidbar yippelu figrechem" (bammidbar 14:29) ha lamadta shehaya ben esrim kesheyyatza mimmitzrayim, uleman deamar nitchalleka haaretz levaeha hare gam hu mode shettachzor leyotze mitzrayim veyanchilu benehem, venogaat hayyerushsha lahem bachazara.

Od yitbaer al pi divre hazzohar (Zohar 10 157.) sheamar ki hammidbar hu mekom shelitat 100 harasha, vezo sibbat peron avonam techef umiyyad, ki lefi shehayu dorsim alav vechofin oto lo hayu massigim geder ze lishlot alav ad shehayu mitrappein minnega avonam, vehu amro met bammidbar perush bishvil heyoto bammidbar shezzulat ze haya Adonai maarich appo ad shehaya metakken maasav velo haya met.

Od yitbaer al derech ma sheamru bazzohar (chelek 3 205:) ki "bammidbar" leshon dibbur, ki bau lehasir millev moshe leval yachshod otam sheyyesh belibbam alav chas veshalom sheyyeavvel mishpatam, veamru avinu met bammidbar perush: ech yaale al haddaat sheyyachshevu davar ze? halo hemma rau et asher hemit Adonai avihem bishvil sheddibber bemoshe, veze ot lahem leharechik machshevot aven beish elohim. veamru reaya laddavar shemmitat avihem hayta bishvil sheddibber bemoshe, shehare lo haya betoch haeda vegomer, vedarshu zichronam livracha (sifre) shekkallu bedivrehem adat meraggelim vaadat korach umitlonnim, vehu lo haya benehem. ha lamadta shello haya lo ella chet haddibbur, shehare kamma kittot shel resha hayu velo nimna immahem. vehu ma sheggamru omer ki vecheto leshon yachid, perush: chet echad haya lo velo yoter. veulay ki laze nitkavvenu ledabber divrehem bifne kol hannesiim vehaeda lehashemiam devarim ellu lehagedil emat moshe belibbam. veefshar ki laze nitkavven beamro "lemor avinu met bammidbar", perush: taam "vattikravna lifne vegomer velifne" vegomer lemor davar ze – avinu met bishvil sheddibber bemoshe, hagam shehaya tzaddik gamur velo haya beyado ella chet echad.

Uvaze nityashsheva temihat hattosafot shehikshu sham beferek yesh nochalin (bava batra 118:) bedibbur hammatchil "uleman deamar levae haaretz" vechulei, shemmiddivre haggemara muchach ki leman deamar nitchalleka levae haaretz lo natlu habbanot chelek tzelafchad hannogea lo leatzmo benachala, ella hannogea lo benachalat chefer keshechazru lo banav. im ken lamma hutzrechu habbanot lomar "vehu lo haya betoch haeda" vegomer, vahalo afillu bene haeda shel hameraggelim natlu bizchut avi avihem? uledarkenu hutzrechu lomar "vehu lo haya" vegomer, lomar "ki vecheto" vegomer kemo shepperashti. vechutz middarkenu yesh leyashshev kushyat hattosafot shehabbanot lo yadu shello niknesu hammeraggelim littol bachazara benichse avihem, vechashvu sheppaka mehammeraggelim nachala baaretz kol ikkar, laze hutzrechu lomar "vehu lo haya" vegomer.

Uvanim lo hayu lo. velo amru en lo, yitbaer al derech amram bene vanim hare hem kevanim, veheelu baggemara (yevamot sav:) shehu haddin bene habbanot, laze amru lo hayu lo kevar aval yesh tikva sheyyihye lo, vehem asher yaldu benotav shehem nikraim gam ken banav:

Vayyomer Adonai vegomer lemor. amro lemor, perush shello yachshov moshe ki maamar "ken benot" vegomer hem haddevarim hanneemarim lemoshe shehikriv hammishpat veen tzorech leamram lezulat, laze amar "lemor" sheyyomar kemo chen lahem. veefshar shello lahem levad ella leyisrael, velaze lo amar "lemor lahem". o efshar mimma sheamar achar kach "veel bene yisrael" vegomer gilla ki ma shekkadam en tzorech leamro ki im livnot tzelafchad, uchefi ze amro "lemor" hu lemor labbanot.

Bene yehuda. parasha zo tirmoz meoraot am bene yisrael, uvachar lirmoz bihuda mehattaam atzmo sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 98,6) lamma nikreu yisrael al shem yehuda. amro bene yehuda hem hattoladot yittachnu beshem banim kayyadua, veamro er veonan yirmoz levayit rishon uvayit sheni, er keneged bayit rishon al derech amro (Shir HaShirim 5:2) "ani yeshena velibbi er", shehaya hakkadosh baruch hu bo er behashegacha gedola immanu babbayit hammekuddash, onan hu bayit sheni ukerao onan leshon onaa, lefi shehaya chaser devarim haikkarim shel bayit hammekuddash.

Veamro vayyamat er veonan hu churban habbattim, ki silluk shechina mehem yikkare mita, shepparcha hannefesh shehi hashshechina venishar habbayit met baavonot umale tumat hakkelippa hannetuna bo kayyadua. gam timtza sheavon shebbo met er hu heavon atzmo sheggaram hachurban, sheamru zichronam livracha (shabbat sav:) shehayu masrichin al mittotehem, vehu maase er, dichtiv (Bereshit 38:9) "veshichet artza", vaavon onan hu avon sheggaram churban bayit sheni shehaya lahem sinat chinnam (yoma 9:) uchemo chen onan dichtiv bo (sham) "levilti netan zera leachiv", gam leshon onaa shehayu meannim ze et ze.

Veamro beeretz kenaan, rasham makom hammekuddash ki hu beeretz kenaan, vesham mitato shechazar likkanes birshut 100 hannikra kenaan. gam yirmoz sibba achat kelalit, vehi sheyyisrael lo horishu hakkenaani venisharu yoshvim bah, veze sibbev lehattotam midderech hammusar kayyadua, vehu ma sheramaz bemaamar "beeretz kenaan".

Veamro vayyihyu bene yehuda yirmoz latztzaar habba lahem achar churban habbayit, vavy hayu bene yehuda baggalut beyad oyvehem. ashre mi shello taam shelitat sone. vetimtza shebbechol hashshevatim lo hizkir hakkatuv lashon ze shel "vayyihyu" ella kan, uvevinyamin, kayyadua hattaam sham.
Veamro lemishpechotam, ki kol mishpechot bet yisrael bechol makom shehem, kol hannikra beshem yehuda vavy hayu.

Veamro leshela nitkavven lemoshia verav habba ligol miggalut haacharon hannikra shela, vahagam sheyyaakov kerao shilo lo yishtanne hashshem baze, vetze ulemad mimmishpachot harshumot kamma hishtannut bashshemot. veulay sheramaz bismichut maamar leshela im maamar vayyihyu vene yehuda shetztzerichin yisrael lehitztaer bishvilo ulekauot lishuato, uchemo sheamru razal bemaase rabbi yehoshua ben levi sheshshealo hammashiach im yisrael makkirim betzaaro vecholim alav vechulei ad kan. uchedivre hazzohar (beshallach noah:) beferush pasuk "kol tzofayich nasu kol" vegomer (Yeshayahu 52:8), vehu maamar "vayyihyu" perush, yihyu bevav shehu hatztzaar, "lemishpechotam", bishvil shela, vehu amro "leshela" vegomer, uvaze yihyu mishpachat hashshelani perush, dor shebben david ba, veyikkaru al shemo doro shel mashiach.

Od yirmoz bema shennedakdek amro hashshelani, veen ot hannun bevinyan hashshem, veen ken minhago lehosif beshem hammishpacha ot chadasha zulat hei veyod, kaamur bechol hakkodmot "chanoch mishpachat hachanochi" vegomer. achen yirmoz lema sheamru zichronam livracha (shabbat lev:) befasuk "vehecheziku vegomer bichnaf ish yehudi" vegomer, yeuyyan sham divrehem, vehu ze sheramaz bemaamar hashshelani, perush, shehaummot kullan yomru lechol echad miyyisrael "shello ani".

Veamro leferetz mishpachat happartzi, yirmoz al derech amram (sanhedrin 20:) shehammelech poretz gader laasot lo derech, vehakkavvana ki bevo habba mipperetz yihyu kol yisrael mishpachat happartzi melachim. veal oto zeman hu sheamru zichronam livracha (bava metzia 113:) kol yisrael bene melachim, vechen amar hannavi (Yeshayahu 49:7) "melachim yiru vekamu" vegomer. gam yirmoz al happirtza haggedola asher yifrotz baummot leen tachlit.

Veamro lezerach mishpachat hazzarchi, yirmoz ma sheamar hakkatuv (Yeshayahu 60:2) "hinne hachoshech vegomer vealayich yizrach Adonai", uchetiv "vehaya lach Adonai leor olam", vehu amro "mishpachat hazzarchi" asher alenu yizrach Adonai.

O tirmoz happarasha lishlosha inyanim sheyyihyu beet happekida: 1 biat mashiach ben efrayim kemaamaram zichronam livracha (socha nov.), 2 gilluy mashiach ben david, 3 kesheyyimloch Adonai alenu. keneged biat mashiach ben efrayim amar shela, veramaz shettifga bo middat haddin veyamut baavonot yisrael, vehu haramuz betevat shela, kederech amro (Shmuel 2 6:7) "vayyakkehu sham al hashshal". ucheneged mashiach ben david amar leferetz vegomer, ki ze yaase peretz baummot veyinkom dam tzaddik. ucheneged malchut olam amar lezerach vegomer, remez lichvod Adonai alenu yizrach.

Veamro vayyihyu bene feretz, amar leshon tzaar lirmoz al hatztzarot asher yihyu bevo haggoel, keamram baggemara (sanhedrin tzach.) "yete velo echmeneh" merov hatztzaar shel chevle mashiach. veamro bene feretz vegomer, perush toladot hayyotzot mibbiat haggoel haramuz beferetz hem shene devarim: 1 sheyyivne Adonai chatzar bet hammelech, vehu bet hammikdash asher paal Adonai vechonnu yadav, veyihyu yisrael mibbene pallatin shello, vehu amro lechetzron mishpachat hachetzroni vehaven. hav lechamul mishpachat hechamuli sheyyachmol alenu bechol anfe hachemla.

Veamro elle mishpechot yehuda. perush, ma sheyyihye lahem mehammeoraot, gam haraot gam hattovot. veamro "lifkudehem", perush, kesheyyihyu nifkadim yesh pekida leraa veyesh pekida letova, kaamur bedivrehem zichronam livracha (Zohar chodesh 1, 160.), ushene mine pekidot neemru bakkatuv.

Veamro shishsha veshivim elef vachamesh meot, ulay sheramaz Adonai baze matay yihye tachlit happekida tova harshuma besamuch sheyyizrach alenu kevod Adonai, veamar ad avor kol galuyyot, galut mitzrayim, vegalut bavel, vegalut edom. keneged galut mitzrayim amar shishsha lirmoz legalut mitzrayim shehaya leshishsha dorot, dichtiv (Bereshit 15:16) "vedor revii yashuvu henna", veayyen ma shekkatavti sham sheshshelosha dorot savlu galut levad miyyitzchak veyaakov vihuda hare shishsha, ki hatechalat haggalut haya mishshennolad yitzchak. ucheneged galut bavel amar veshivim dichtiv (Yirmeyahu 29:10) ad limlot levavel shivim shana. ucheneged galut edom sheanu adayin bo amar elef vachamesh meot, veim hayu zochim yisrael hayu nimnim 172 shana shennisharu meelef harvii, vechevan shello zachu yatchil hacheshbon meelef hachamishi vachamesh meot meelef hashshishshi, umekavvim anu ki hu ze ketz galuyyotenu veyitkayyemu kol hayyiudim harshumim veyatchilu nitzotze gilluy haggeulla behatechalat chamesh meot habbaim leshalom.

rashi: Vayyikkach et yehoshua. lekacho vidvarim vehodio mattan sechar parnese yisrael laolam habba (sifre):
ohc: Vayyaas moshe kaasher vegomer. perush, samuch lemitzvat hammelech, vahagam she lo tzivva lo chen ella teshuva lemaamaro, veen hechreach sheyyaase haddavar techef, af al pi chen miher asot maamar Adonai.

rashi: Vayyomer moshe el bene yisrael. lehafsik hainyan, divre rabbi yishmael, lefi shead kan devarav shel makom ufarashat nedarim matchelet bedibburo shel moshe, hutzrach lehafsik techilla velomar shechazar moshe veamarah farasha zo leyisrael, sheim lo chen, yesh bemashma shello amar lahem zo, ella befarashat nedarim hitchil devarav:
ohc: Kechol asher vegomer et moshe. velo hispik lomar "oto" umuvan sheal moshe hu omer, lehaircha shehu maamar bifne atzmo shehem divre hattora shemmeida veomeret shehammaamar mimmennu alehem haya kechol asher tzivva Adonai et moshe, ma shello haya nishma im haya omer "oto" sheaz haya nishma shehu gemar maamar "vayyomer moshe vegomer kechol asher tzivva Adonai oto", vaadayin ani omer shehu chashav ken umi yomar shello taa bidvarav velo shinna behessach haddaat.
Chassalat parashat pinchas

rashi: Yifkod Adonai. kevan sheshama moshe sheamar lo hammakom ten nachalat tzelofchad livnotav, amar higgia shaa sheetba tzorki — sheyyireshu banay et gedullati, amar lo hakkabbah lo chach olta vemachashava lefanay, keday hu yehoshua littol sechar shimmusho shello mash mittoch haohel (Shemot 33:11), vezehu sheamar shelomo (Mishlei 27) "notzer teena yochal piryah" (tanchuma):

Elohe haruchot. lamma neemar? amar lefanav, ribbono shel olam, galuy lefanecha dato shel kol echad veechad, veenan domin ze laze, manne alehem manhig sheyyehe sovel kol echad veechad lefi dato (yalkut shemauni):
ohc: Yifkod Adonai elohe haruchot vegomer. tzarich ladaat: 1 lamma bachar kinnuy ze mikkol kinnuye hammaala vehashshevach hayyeduim laAdonai. 2 lamma heerich lashon asher yetze vegomer vaasher yavo vaasher yotziem vaasher yeviem. 3 amro velo tihye adat vegomer, minnayin yaale al haddaat she yalim eno mibbanav sheyyihyu katztzon asher vegomer.

Achen yitbaer hainyan al ze hadderech: da ki techunat hassechel uvechirato ushelilato rechoka begeder hannishtevan beribbuy hannosim, ucheshem sheyyishtannu hannivraim betzuratam uvekomatam veen hahishtauut bahem, kemo chen veyoter mehemma beinyan hishtannut hannivchar vehannishlal bivchinat hahaskel veharatzon, nosaf al shinnuy perate hatteva bitchunat haharkava shebbayyesodot vechochot hiyyuliyyim asher mehem yivvaled habbechira baddomim, veyimmatze lifamim hahishtauut battechuna vehu nelam, vehu ma shekkivvenu razal (nedarim lat:) lomar "ben gilo" beinyan bikkur cholim. umizze teshaer sheyyushlal begeder hannimtza sheyyishtauu rabbim kahemma shishshim ribbo shehayu bedoro shel moshe leechad, vehammelech asher yasim Adonai alehem lo yishtauu birtzonam elav, zulat haish moshe sheamru zichrono livracha (Tikkunei Zohar 69) shehaya shoresh kol hanneshamot shel dor hammidbar, besod amro (Yeshayahu 63:11) "moshe ammo", veayyen ma shekkatavti befasuk (Bamidbar 11:12) "heanochi hariti" vegomer. vezo hayta sibba shehammafkid vehannifkadim nimzegu legeder hahishtauut vechol echad haya lo kilvavo.

Veze hu gam ken taam shetztzivva Adonai asot shoftim lishvatecha vechulei, lefi shehashshevet yitkarev battechuna laanafav. veze yada uvachan moshe alav hashshalom veamar teshuva lemaamar hammita: yifkod Adonai – perush yemanne, el elohe haruchot – perush sheyyodea ruach shel kol basar vegeder techunatam, temanne echad sheyyihye tivo shave bitchuna lechol haeda, sheyyaskim hu lema sheyyomru hem veyaskimu hem lema sheyyomar hu lahem. vehu amro asher yetze lifnehem – perush sheyyihye lo haratzon bahem, vaasher yotziem vegomer – sheyyihye lahem haratzon kamohu latzet velavo immo. vetala haddavar bo ki hu hammelech, uvechira kazot hi muchletet hassaga mizzulato yitbarach, ki hu levaddo yodea tochen haruchot veyeda ruach shettitmazzeg im kullan. veish kaze eno bannimtza zulat im yihye adam kemoshe shekkol yisrael hem anafav vehu shoresh lechullam, vezulat ze tihye adat Adonai katztzon asher en lahem roe. vetachlit kavvanat divre moshe laAdonai hu al ze hadderech: ani eese kaasher adoni dover, aval yetukkan davar ze kodem im yuchal lehikkanes begeder hattikkun, veim lo – tihye adat Adonai katztzon vegomer. vehayyotze mizze hu velo yamut, karamuz betevat "lemor" sheamarnu, umittoch haddevarim atta lamed sheim yimmatze ish kaze hinne hu maskim gam hu leasef el ammav kemaamaro yitbarach.

rashi: Kaasher tzivva vegomer'. sheyyehe minyanam mibben eshorim shana vamala, shenneemar "kol haover al happekudim" vegomer' (Shemot 30):
ohc: Mibben esrim shana. tzarich ladaat lamma lo hizkir hammispar shealav chozer maamar mibben esrim, veim samach sheal hammispar hu omer keamur besamuch, im ken gam maamar mibben esrim vegomer haya lo lismoch shehuzekar besamuch velo yitztarech lehazekiro. ulefi ma shepperashti bappasuk shellifne ze shebba hammispar bearvot moav gam ken lehareot shello chasru al yado, yitchayyev haddavar limnot gam hakketannim, shezzulat ze en shevach shello chasru ki leolam chasru ella sheggadlu haggedayim venaasu teyashim, veyesh makom lomar ki lechullan mana, laze amar "mibben esrim shana", venatan hakkatuv taam laddavar kaasher tzivva Adonai ki im haya haddavar mitztzad moshe levad lehachezir hatztzon beminyan velo haya devar Adonai ella letzauoto al haddavar, dichtiv: "seu et rosh" vegomer, lo haya moshe mone et yisrael lirtzono hagam sheyyihye lo taam baddavar, laze lo mana ella mibben esrim kaasher tzivva vegomer.

Uvene yisrael hayyotzim meeretz mitzrayim. en yadua hakkavvana bemaamar ze. verabbi avraham ibben ezra amar ki yirtze lomar shehayu bassefurim rabbim miyyotze mitzrayim. veen taam lamma yodia hakkatuv inyan ze, veod vadday sheani yodea shehayu vahem miyyotze mitzrayim shello nigzera gezera ella al hayyotzim mibben esrim. veulay shekkavvanat hakkatuv hi lehodiacha shennimnu venimtzeu bene yisrael kemispar hayyotzim meeretz mitzrayim, lo kammispar shebbefarashat bammidbar, sheshsham hayu shesh meot elef usheloshet alafim vachamesh meot vachamishshim, umispar ze ala leshesh meot elef veelef usheva meot usheloshim shechaser lammispar bammidbar. veen chiyyuv al moshe ella lehachezir bamminyan shehufkedu etzlo battechilla, vehinne hu misparam shalem. veshiur hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: "uvene yisrael" ala minyanam leminyan hayyotzim vegomer velo lematta mehem. o yirtze al ze hadderech, ki misparam haya keseder mispar hayyotzim meeretz mitzrayim shemmanu lemishpachot, dichtiv (Bereshit 46:10): "bene reuven chanoch ufallu, bene shimon yemuel veyamin" vegomer, kemo chen mispar ze hayu monim lemishpachot karashum bainyan, velo kederech shennimnu bemidbar sinay shello huzkar sham perate hammishpachot.

rashi: Yachoggu. leshon shever hu, vechen "bechagve hassela" (Shir HaShirim 2:14), vechen "vehayta admat yehuda lemitzrayim lechagga" (Yeshayahu 19:17):
targum: Yirtetun yenuun hech ravya dachamar vechol chuchemathon mistalama:

rashi: Pinechas ben elazar ben aharon hakkohen. lefi shehayu hashevatim mevazzim oto — haritem ben puti ze sheppittem avi immo agalim laaza veharag nesi shevet miyyisrael? lefichach ba hakkatuv veyichaso achar aharon (Sanhedrin 82):
Bekano et kinati. benokmo et nikmati — bekotzpo et hakketzef shehaya li liktzof; kol leshon kina hu hammitchare linkom nikmat davar, anprtmnt belaaz:
ohc: Pinchas ben elazar vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach leyachaso, veulay shennitkavven sheyyizzachru avotav letova. veod nire shennitkavven lehashelim yisrael im aharon shessibbev nefila gedola miyyisrael beemtzaut haegel, dichtiv (Shemot 32:35): "vayyiggof Adonai et haam al asher asu et haegel asher asa aharon". hare amad pinchas ben beno ufada nefesh kol yisrael, keamro besamuch "velo chilliti et bene yisrael". velaze yichaso ad aharon, vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha bammidrash (451 deve eliyyahu Rabba perek 13) shehaya aharon omed umetakken vehaya melammed kol yisrael tora umaasim tovim vechulei, ad kan. ha lamadta shehaya nechshav al aharon hakkilkul sheggaram bemitat am rav vehaya mevakkesh letakken ma shennifratz, vechan ramaz Adonai ki pinchas shillem bemidda tova merubba.

Heshiv et chamati. kavvanat hodaat davar ze ulay shebba lomar lo shello yachshov shehashshem heshiv et chamato belo emtzaut zechut asher kafa middat haddin, veyetze mizze sheyyachshov moshe ki hashshem mitnaheg beseder ze, lachen hodia hashshem ki pinchas hu shehaya sibba lehashiv chema, vehu amro heshiv et chamati velo meatzmah shava.

Meal bene yisrael. perush, achar sheyyatzta hachema vehayta alehem, heshivah mealehem, veze shevach gadol. od nitkavven lomar maase hattov begeder happeulla atzmah, shehesir kaas Adonai, ki hakkaas hu anaf hayyagon vehaddaavon, veyihye laAdonai nachat ruach harebe mehashavat chema.

Bekano et kinati betocham. dikdek lomar kinati, gam amar betocham, ba latet koach hammassig bo hashavat chema, veamar shehayta beemtzaut shelosha devarim: haechad shekkinne bichvodo uveatzmo vesikken beatzmo kaamur bedivrehem, vehu amro bekano bechinnuy. 2, shehayta hakkina bishvil kevodi levad lo leemtzaut shum davar zulato, vezo hi mitzva shelema asher yitratztze Adonai bah yoter mikkol asher yaase haadam, vehu amro et kinati bechinnuy lehammedabber baruch hu. 3, shello hayta happeulla sheasa neelemet meene adam ella kiddesh Adonai betoch kahal veeda, keamram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 82.) shehayu kol shevet shimon saviv laohel asher sham dakar shenehem veharag nesiehem bifnehem, vehu amro betocham:

Velo chilliti vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma katav hassibba shehi "bekano et kinati betocham" beemtza shene perate hammesubbav shehem "heshiv et chamati" velo chilliti" vegomer, shehaya lo lomar al ze hadderech "bekano vegomer heshiv vegomer velo chilliti" vegomer, o al ze hadderech "heshiv vegomer velo chilliti vegomer bekano" vegomer?

Achen nitkavven lehair ki hashavat hachema achar shehayta al bene yisrael, geder ze lo husag ella beemtzaut shalosh haderagot elyonot harshumim bainyan, kemo shepperashti bappasuk "bekano" vegomer, aval legabbe meniat hakkillayon sheamar "velo chilliti", efshar shehaya gam ken Adonai mashir peleta leammo, hagam shello haya bammaase kol shalosh maalot haamurot bainyan, uveemtzaut tefillat tzaddik vechaddome mehazzechut yomar Adonai lammalach hammashchit "rav" vegomer. gam lefi ma shepperashti beamro "heshiv et chamati" shehu davar tov begeder happeulla mitztzad atzmah, behechreach lomar hakkatuv beseder ze, ki im haya omer "heshiv" vegomer "velo chilliti" veachar kach yomar "bekano", haya nishma ki tachlit inyan ze shel hashavat chema hu hannimshach mimmennu shello killa et bene yisrael, veen muvan sheyyesh mifal tov bahashavat chema mitztzad atzmah. aval meamro "heshiv et chamati" veamar samuch lah sibbat haddavar shehu "bekano" vegomer, ze yaggid shekkevar hodia tachlit mifal hattov.

rashi: Uvene korach lo metu. hem hayu vaetza techilla, uvishat hammachaloket hirharu teshuva velibbam, lefichach nitbatztzer lahem makom gavoha bagehinnom veyashevu sham (Sanhedrin 110):
ohc: Uvene korach lo metu. hodia hakkatuv inyan ze kan velo bimkom ikkar hammaase, gam lo ketavo bimkom mispar haleviyyim ki sham mekom hodaat hammetim mehem, lefi ma shekkatavnu ki kan ba elohim likboa heavon bedatan vaaviram ulehakel meal korach, laze gamar omer uvene korach lo metu, hakkavvana shezze yaggid zechut avihem shello shetafam chovo kederech sheshshataf chovam shel datan vaaviram kol battehem leheyotam ikkar hammachloket.
Lachodesh hazze. tevat hazze meyutteret, uderashuha razal (torat kohanim 23,6) lemaet sukkot mimmatztza, uchevar perashtiha befarashat tazria (Vayikra 14,7).

rashi: Asher hitztzu. et yisrael al moshe:
Behatztzotam. et haam al Adonai:
Hitztzu. hissiu et yisrael lariv al moshe, leshon hifilu:
ohc: Hu datan vaaviram vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma ba lelammedenu bemaamar ze. veim lehodia ki hen henna haamurim bemaase korach – davar pashut hu sheen litot shehayu datan vaaviram acherim bene eliav acher. veod, meikkara lo haya lo lehazekiram vehayu kelo hayu kishar hammishpachot shessafu tammu velo nimnu. od, lamma heerich baddevarim ellu asher hitztzu vegomer behatztzotam al Adonai.

Venire ki lo ba hakkatuv kan ella lomar shehen henna hayu sibba lechol maase korach, ki yachpotz Adonai lefarsem harshaim shehem sibba laresha hannaase, vehu amro hu datan vegomer asher hitztzu vegomer, perush, et acherim al Adonai umoshe avdo, vechen peresh Rashi, ha lamadta shehem hammachtiim haeda hannoedet. veefshar sheggam et korach hem hechetiuhu, vahagam sheamar hakkatuv "vayyikkach korach" (Bamidbar 16:1) shennire shemmeatzmo asa, efshar shehaya lema shekkadam lo mehem, uleolam hem hitztzu oto. veamro vattiftach vegomer achar shehaddevarim kevar ketuvin befarashat korach, nitkavven lomar sheggam beliat korach vaachilat haesh matayim vachamishshim ish hem hayu sibba lammeora mittechilla vead sof. ha lamadta shehagam shennikhalu hayyehudim al moshe veal aharon hayu chozrim bahem im lo hayu shene harshaim.

Veze lecha haot ki haish moshe lo haya mishtaddel leratztzot ella lahem, dichtiv (Bamidbar 16:12) "vayyishlach moshe likro ledatan" vegomer, uchetiv (Bamidbar 16:25) "vayyelech moshe el datan" vegomer shehirgish shebbahem haddavar taluy. meatta nafshot kol hammetim teluyim bishne harshaim hahem, veyesh baze limmud zechut al korach veal hammatayim vachamishshim ish. vechen timtza sheamar hakkatuv befarashat ekev (Devarim 11:6) "vaasher asa ledatan velaaviram" vegomer sheeno mone hammeora ella ledatan vaaviram. uchefi ze yecholin anu lehaamid sevarat haomer (sanhedrin kach.) adat korach en lahem chelek laolam habba bedatan vaaviram, ulehaamid sevarat haomer alehem amar hakkatuv "morid sheol vayyaal" bishar haeda chutz mehem.

rashi: Velifne elazar hakkohen yaamod. hare sheelatecha sheshaalta, sheen hakkavod hazze zaz mibbet avicha, sheaf yehoshua yehe tzarich leelazar (tanchuma):
Veshaal lo. kesheyyitztarech latzet lammilchama:
Al piv. shel elazar:
Vechol haeda. sanhedrin:
ohc: Al piv yetzu vegomer. perush, chozer al Adonai haamur besamuch, hu hammotzi vehammevi behodaat haurim vehattumim.

rashi: Lehaggid babboker chasdecha. beet haggeulla:
Veemunatcha ballelot. uveod tzarat haggalut lehaamin becha shettishmor havetachatcha, kol ze nae vetov:
targum: Letanaa betzafra tuvach vekushetach belelvan:

rashi: Kach lecha. kachennu bidvarim — ashrecha shezzachita lehanhig banav shel makom:
Lecha. et shebbaduk lecha, et sheatta makkir:
Asher ruach bo. kaasher shaalta, sheyyuchal lahaloch keneged rucho shel kol echad veechad (sifre):
Vesamachta et yadecha alav. ten lo meturgeman sheyyidrosh bechayyecha, shello yomru alav, lo haya lo leharim rosh bime moshe:
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai vegomer kach lecha vegomer asher ruach bo. tzarich ladaat amro kach lecha, od amro asher ruach bo vechi yesh adam sheen bo ruach? od tzarich ladaat ma zo semicha. achen lefi ma shepperashti bedivre moshe baa hatteshuva shepperush amro "kach lecha", perush kachashashtecha velidvarecha kach et yehoshua, veda shehu ish asher ruach bo, perush atta yeshnecha shoresh kol hanneshamot vehu yeshno bivchinat haruach, vehu amro asher ruach bo perush shoresh kol ruchot haddor hahu. vetzivva Adonai lismoch yado lehair laruach mahut hanneshama shebbemoshe, vehu amro levassof lemaan yishmeu kol adat bene yisrael semucha lemaamar "venatatta mehodcha alav", lomar shebbaze yihye gam ken kalul mishshoresh hanneshamot, uvaze "yishmeu", perush yekabbelu maamarav, "kol adat bene yisrael", perush, tihye gam ken techunat haanashim hashshelemim baale hanneshama merutztzet mimmennu.

rashi: Kanita kedem. lifne beriyat olam, shenneemar "maon atta hayita lanu, beterem harim yulladu" (tehillim 90:1-2):
Ze shachanta bo. tikkun lashon hu, kemo "zu chatanu lo" (Yeshayahu 42:24), vehu kemo asher shachanta bo:
targum: Idkar kenishtach dikneta milkadmin perakta mimitzrayim shivte achsantach tur detzion denan di shareta shechintach beh:

rashi: Uveyom habbikkurim. chag hashavuot karuy bikkure ketzir chittim al shem shette hallechem, shehem rishonim leminchat chittim habbaim min hechadash (Menachot 84):
ohc: Behakerivchem vegomer beshavuotechem. nitkavven lomar ki en hechag al siman mincha chadasha levad, ella gam letashlum sefirat hashshavuot, ki hu tikkun gadol lenishmot am bene yisrael kaamur besifre anshe emet. vedikdek lomar "beshavuotechem" bechinnuy, lehair ki hashshiva shavuot hem bechinat shiva hatztzaddikim yesode am bene yisrael, kaamur besefer hazzohar (Tikkunim 21:).

Od nitkavven beamro beshavuotechem lishlol daat shotim (menachot 65:) shessovrim bema sheamar hakkatuv "mimmochorat hashshabbat" (Vayikra 23:15) hu shabbat bereshit, laze amar beshavuotechem perush hashshavuot shellachem, veim perush maamar "mimmochorat hashshabbat" shabbat bereshit, en sheviiyyot ellu shellahem ella sheviiyyot olam. kayyotze baddavar matzinu sheamru babberayta (menachot av.) veze leshonam: rabbi yehuda omer "tispar lach" (Devarim 16:9) – yatzta shabbat bereshit shessefiratah bechol adam.

rashi: Ken benot tzelofchad doverot. ketargumo, "yaut" — kach ketuva farasha zo lefanay bammarom, maggid sheraata enan ma shello raata eno shel moshe (tanchuma):
Ken benot tzelofchad doverot. yafe taveu, ashre adam shehakkabbah mode lidvarav (sifre):
Naton titten. shene chalakim, chelek avihen shehaya miyyotzee mitzrayim, vechelko im echav benichse chefer (Bava Batra 118):

Vehaavarta. leshon evra hu bemi sheeno manniach ben leyorsho. daa — al shem shehabbat maaveret nachala mishevet leshevet, shebbenah uvalah yoreshin otah — shelo tissov nachala" (Bamidbar 36) lo nitztavva ella leoto haddor bilvad (Bava Batra 120) — vechen vehaavartem et nachalato levitto, bechullan hu omer "unetattem" uvabbat hu omer "vehaavartem":
ohc: Ken benot tzelafchad vegomer. hutzrach lomar ken velo hispik bema shepperat hammishpatim, lomar shedderech hammishpat sheshshaftu besichlam lechol happerushim shepperashnu, ben lefi ma sheamar hattanna dechachmaniyyot hayu sheshshaftu din yerushsha middin yibbum – hitzdik Adonai ma sheddanu besichlam, ben ma sheamru middaat atzman shennogea lahem chelke habbechora vechelek achihem. od nitchakkem Adonai lomar "ken" vegomer lehair ki kol perate haddinim asher yetzav Adonai bainyan, kemo sheddarshu zichronam livracha babbarayta bemassechet bava batra (118:) veze leshonam: "naton titten" – zo nachalat avihen, "betoch ache" vegomer – zo nachalat avi avihen, "vehaavarta" – zo bechora vechulei, veamar rabbi elazar af chelek achi avihen vechulei dichtiv "naton titten" vegomer – lechol ellu happeratim nitkavvenu benot tzelafchad bedivrehem, vehu amro ken benot vegomer, vechazar lefaresh devarim shekkalal bemaamar "ken". ha lamadta shehayta kavvanatam lishol kol haamur, uchevar remaznum lemala bedivrehem.

Venitkavven Adonai gam ken leromem hatztzadkaniyyot hachachmaniyyot, veulay ki laze nitkavven betevat lemor leshon maala, kederech amro (Devarim 26:18) "heemircha hayyom" lerommam bemaamar "ken benot tzelafchad dovrot". od nitkavven Adonai leyached lahem teshuva lemishpatan bifne atzman, velo kelalan yachad bemitzva achat im yisrael keshetztzivva besamuch, dichtiv: "veel bene yisrael tedabber lemor", lehareot et asher yechabbed mechabbedav veose retzono.

Bene zevulun vegomer. ramaz hakkatuv maasehem vehammussag mimmennu, sered kemo seder, vechen derech hakkatuv likrot lecheves kesev, vehakkavvana baze shehaya mesadder lifne yissashchar kol hatztzarich lo limzonotav, veelon leshon chozek, veramaz al derech amro (Mishlei 3:18) "etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah", veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 25:1) lelomdeha lo neemar vechulei, velaze lefi shezzevulun haya machazik beyad lomde tora yiches lo midda zo, vehu amro leelon.

rashi: Zivchu zivche tzedek. hatzediku maasechem, vahare attem kimkerivim zevachim:
Uvitchu el Adonai. sheyyashpia lachem tova, veal techetau lo bishvil mamon, sheattem metzappim lekabbel sachar meet shaul:
targum: Kevashu yitzrechon veyitchashev lechon kenichsat tzidka vesabbaru al Adonai:

rashi: Veshem ish yisrael vegomer'. bemakom sheyyiches et hatztzaddik leshevach, yiches et harasha lignay (tanchuma):

Nesi vet av lashimoni. leechad mechameshet batte avot shehayu leshevet shimon; daa — lehodia shivcho shel pinechas, sheaf al pi shezze haya nasi, lo mana et atzmo millekanne lechillul hashem, lechach hodiacha hakkatuv mi hu hammukke:
ohc: Veshem ish yisrael. kashe, mimma nafshach: im chafetz Adonai legallot hammukkim, haya lo lehazekiram bishat maase kesheamar (Bamidbar 25:6) "vehinne ish mibbene yisrael", sham haya makom lehazekiro velomar "vehinne ish vegomer zimri" vegomer, ucheshehizkir gam ken hammidyanit haya lo lehazekir shemah. veim tora kisseta alehem kederech shekkisseta al hammekoshesh beshabbat, lamma nimlach lehazekir shemam vehutzrach gam ken lehosif od tevot yeterot battora, sheim haya mazkir shemam lemala lo haya tzarich lomar paam sheniyya "veshem ish vegomer veshem haishsha" vegomer?

Achen hinne haadon baruch hu eno chafetz lezalzel afillu barshaim lefarsem mi baale devarim hammetoavim, umekoshesh yochiach. gam bema shellefanenu tire shello gilla otam bishat maase, ella davka achar shehizkir shevach pinchas asher paal veasa mehammifal hattov shekkinne laAdonai vechipper al bene yisrael, zachar gam ken ki lo kinne beadam pachut ella beadam gadol nesi bet av im haishsha rosh hakkelippot veaviha melech, keamro "rosh ummot bet av", venitava bemita bezuya leen kol, uvechol kayyotze baze shemo yitbarach mitkaddesh, laze yichasah lomar bat melech hi, vahagam sheyyesh zilzul leish yisrael lo yigra mitztzaddik eno, kederech amro (Mishlei 10:7) "zecher tzaddik livracha" hagam sheshshem reshaim yirkav" beemtzaut ken. veulay ki lehodiacha ba hakkatuv shello hissig hashavat hachema vechulei ella beemtzaut davar ze sheasa hakkina benasi venitkaddesh shemo kiddush gadol venichnea koach hasm umaas heavon kol kach beene chol, baze heshiv chema vaychapper vegomer, aval zulat ze hagam shehaya mekanne laAdonai beadam hedyot lo haya massig kol hadderagot harshumot.

Vedikdek lomar veshem haish velo hispik bemaamar "veshem hammukke" vegomer, lefi darkenu yirtze leshon chashivut, lomar ki haya chashuv umeulle beyisrael, veim kol ze lo nirta tzaddik ze measot bo maase hannifla. od nire ki taam shello hizkir Adonai shemo lemala (Bamidbar 25:6) lefi sheadayin lo asa maase ella chashav laasot, vechol od shello asa lo tevazzehu hattora lehazekir shemo, veachar shekkevar asa maase pirsem Adonai shemo ki mitzva lefarsem harshaim.

Hammukke asher hukka vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar hammukke asher hukka velo hispik beachat mehenna. gam tzarich ladaat lamma shinna hakkatuv mitteva hammaamar shehitchil ledabber bo keshehizkir shem yisrael shehikdim lomar ish yisrael veachar kach amar hammeora hammukke vegomer, ucheshehizkir hammidyanit hikdim hammeora veshem haishsha hammukka veachar ken amar hammidyanit?

Achen yitbaer hainyan al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (berachot 18:) sheamru sheharshaim bechayyehem keruyim metim, vehattaam hu lefi shekkoach hara shehu bechinat hammet devuka bahem. uchevar katavti bechamma mekomot ki hashshem sheyyikkare bo haadam hu shem hannefesh, vaAdonai sam shemot baaretz keamram zichronam livracha (berachot 7:) al tikre shammot ella vechulei, uchesheadam chote nifgema nafsho bidvekut hara bechinat hammarkiv, vehu amro (Mishlei 10:7) "veshem reshaim yirkav", velaze haya rabbi meir bodek bashshem (yoma fag:) lirot im baal nefesh yeshara hu. vehinne ze asher baal aramit hishchit nafsho befigo bah vehinne hu mukke makkat mavet kodem sheharago pinchas, vehu ma shennitkavven hakkatuv lomar veshem ish yisrael hammukke asher hukka vegomer, keneged hakkaat hannefesh amar "veshem ish yisrael hammukke", shemmeet asher gaal nafsho uva aleha hukka makkat nefesh hayyisreelit, shehi kinnuy nefesh kedosha hannikret yisrael, ucheneged harigato sheharago pinchas amar "asher hukka et" vegomer, keamro (Bamidbar 25:8) "vayyidkor et shenehem". o al ze hadderech, "hammukke" perush shehikkahu pinchas, "asher hukka et hammidyanit", hu hakkaat hannefesh sherasham betevat "ish". viduyyak al nachon gam ken amro "hukka et hammidyanit", ki lefi sheshshachav otah hukka benafsho, uchefi ze shiur tevat "asher hukka" perush, shekkevar hukka et hammidyanit, perush lihyoto ittah.

Od ramaz beamro et hammidyanit al derech amro (Bereshit 39:10): "velo shama eleha lishkav etzlah lihyot immah", veamru zichronam livracha (yoma la.): "lishkav etzlah" baolam hazze, "lihyot immah" laolam habba. vehu amro hukka et hammidyanit shehakkaato hi sheyyihye ittah immah baolam habba, ki min hassetam met shello mittoch teshuva, shehare dekaro bishat maase. uvaze nityashshev ma sheddikdaknu lamma kafal "hammukke asher hukka", gam taam shehikdim lomar "ish yisrael" kodem amro "hammukke", kede sheyyihye chozer amro "hammukke" al hashshem, lomar shehahakkaa baa lo gam beshem "ish yisrael" shehi anaf hakkedushsha. velaze keshehizkir hammidyanit lo hizkir bah ella hakkaa achat, dichtiv "veshem haishsha hammukka", gam lo hikdim zichronah kodem zichron hahakkaa, ki bechayyeha keruya meta ushemah mukke veomed karashum betevat "midyanit". uchevar katavnu bechamma mekomot ki shem ovde kochavim umazzalot hu shem hakkelippot shekkullan hem bechinot hammita.

Od yitbaer al ze hadderech al pi ma shekkadam lanu middivre hammekubbalim shello yiddach niddach mikkol nitzotze hakkedushsha, vechullan levassof yizku lammakom shemmimmennu bau. vahagam sheyyarea ish yisrael af yatzriach nafsho, sof kol sof yachzor lesharsho. vehu amro veshem ish yisrael, hare sheafillu achar maase beshem yisrael yechunne, ha lamadta shello neekar mishsharsho. hammukke perush shehikka pinchas, modiacha hakkatuv shello hukka beavdan nafsho, ella "asher hukka et hammidyanit", perush, oto hachelek hara shennidbak bo meet hammidyanit sheyyitkanne elav shem hakkaa, hu shehukka vamet beemtzaut hakkaat pinchas. ha lamadta sheyyatza hefsedo ma shehifsid baavera, nifra mimmennu heavon behakkaato shel pinchas sheharago umitato kapparato. o al ze hadderech shello hukka benafsho ella keshehaya immah, aval achar shennivdal mimmenna lo nishar bo roshem hachet ki hu nivdal bemita umitato tihara nafsho. uvaze natan taam lamma kerao ish yisrael, ki achar hariga beshem yisrael yechunne. ze katavti im efshar.

rashi: Vayyakrev moshe et mishpatan. nitallema halacha mimmennu, vechan nifra al shennatal atara lomar (Devarim 1) "vehaddavar asher yikshe mikkem takrivun elay"; daa — reuya hayeta farasha zo lehikkatev al yede moshe, ella shezzachu venot tzelofchad venichteva al yadan (Bava Batra 119; Sanhedrin 8):
ohc: Vayyakrev moshe vegomer. efshar shennitkavven lefi divre tanna dechachmaniyyot vechulei sheheveti befasuk "lamma yiggara", sheshshaftu im anu keven nirash veim lav tityabbem immenu, kemo chen dibber moshe lifne Adonai. vetamo sheamar ken, lesheim yomar lo Adonai en lahem nachala yitten lo taam lamma lo tityabbem immam.

Od yitbaer al pi ma sheamru bevava batra (119:) veze leshonam: amar rabbi chidka: shimon hashshikmoni haya li chaver mittalmide rabbi akiva, vechach haya omer – yodea haya moshe shebbenot tzelafchad yorshot, aval lo haya yodea im notlot chelek bechora, ureuya hayta parashat nechalot likkatev al pi moshe ella shezzachu benot tzelafchad venichteva al yadan, ureuya hayta parashat mekoshesh vechulei ella shennitchayyev mekoshesh venichteva al yado, ad kan. vechatvu hattosafot sham bedibbur hammatchil "yodea haya moshe vechulei": af al pi shello neemra parashat nechalot, yodea haya mittaam im keven anu nirash, im kevat tityabbem immenu, kedilkamman (Bamidbar 27:4), ad kan.

Vekashe ledivre barayta zo mibbarayta (zevachim 115:) shennechleku rabbi akiva verabbi yishmael beseder netinat hattora, shekkullam modim shenneemru kelalot hattora uferateha besinay. ulefi barayta zo lo neemar lemoshe im yittelu chelek bechora im lo ad shenat haarbaim shehaya bearvot moav achar mitat aharon, shekken amar hakkatuv "velifne elazar", ha lamadta shemmet aharon. bishlama parashat mekoshesh lefi shehayta beshana rishona keamram zichronam livracha (sifre 9 113:) nuchal lomar shehaya Adonai omrah lemoshe besinay ella shennitchayyev mekoshesh vechulei, ma sheen ken ma shellefanenu. veod kefi ze met aharon chaser yediat hattora bifrat din ze.

Venire ki leolam kol mishpete hattora neemru lemoshe besinay kelalot uferatot, uchemo chen parashat nachalot, vehaya yodea moshe veaharon shehabbanot yittelu gam chelek habbechora. uma sheamru babbarayta lo haya yodea sheyyittelu chelek habbechora, perush beeretz yisrael, hakkavvana im techashev rauy o muchezak, lefi sheen habbechor notel pi shenayim ella bemuchezak velo berauy. vedavar ze lo ba mechamat chesron yediat hahalacha ella chesron yediat metziut ze im karuy muchezak o rauy, vechesron yediat davar ze eno chesron dine hattora. vechen mochichim haddevarim mimma sheamru sham baggemara shemmakshe mibberayta zo shel rabbi shimon hashshikmoni lerava sheamar eretz yisrael muchezeket hi, veamar: vei salka datach muchezeket hi, may ka mesappeka leh? umetaretz: hi gufa mesappeka leh bemashmaut dikra (Shemot 6:8) "venatatti otah lachem morasha" vegomer. perush, im perush morasha hu yerushsha uchefi ze habbechor yittol bah pi shenayim, o dilma perush morasha hu sheyyihyu morishin otah. ufashtu leh yerushsha lachem umorishin livnehem, vehayenu dichtiv (Shemot 15:17): "teviemo vetittaemo" vegomer, melammed shemmitnabbeim veenam yodim ma vechulei, ad kan. haddevarim maggidim shehassafek haya baaretz lo bemishpat habbechora shekkevar neemra parashat nachalot, sheim lo chen ma makshe hattalmud bamme nistappek moshe kevan sheadayin lo neemra parashat nachalot ad otah shaa.

Venitbaer gam ken mehaggemara sheggam mishpat eretz yisrael im hi muchezeket o reuya neemra battora, ella shennistappek moshe beferush morasha. vegam oto safek yesh lo berur battora mippasuk "teviemo vetittaemo" (Shemot 15:17), velo hirgish bo, keamro mitnabbeim veenam yodim vechulei. umeatta amro vayyakrev moshe et mishpatan hu taanat habbechora baaretz, veamar leh rachmana vehaavarta et nachalat vegomer, uferash sham sheddoresh remez habbechora mittevat "vehaavarta" kedichtiv (Shemot 13:12) "vehaavarta chol peter rechem". vahagam shettimtza shekkol inyan hannachalot katuv kan, bizmanno neemar besinay ella shennikba kan, kederech sheamru zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 59:) beinyan mila vegid hannashe (chullin 100:) shebbesinay neemru ella shennikbeu sham. ella shennishar lanu leda hechan ramzu habbanot bedivrehem taanat habbechora sheomer shealeha hikriv moshe mishpatan. veulay ki en tzorech sheyyishalu im haddayyan yodea sheyyesh lahem zechut ma shello huzekar bedivrehem venistappek bo, yishal alav lelohe hammishpat. o efshar sheramzuha bemaamar lamma yiggara shem avinu, sheratzu sheyyihye haddavar lahem keillu avihem hu hannichnas laaretz, vehaddavar muvan shertzonam lomar sheyyitlu chelek habbechora baaretz. ulefi ze amro mishpatan perush, hammishpat shettavu bechelek habbechora.

rashi: Leozni. omer ani shezzo mishpachat etzbon (Bereshit 46), veeni yodea lamma lo nikret mishpachto al shemo:
ohc: Leazni. peresh Rashi: omer ani shezzo mishpachat etzbon veen ani yodea vechulei, ad kan. veen nire lehametzi davar sheen lo taam veeno middivrehem zichronam livracha. veod kashe shebbemidrash rabbi tanchuma amru veze leshonam: uchesheatta mone mishpachat gad en sham etzbon, ki chasar al hazzenut baatzat bilam, ad kan. asher al ken haya nire ki azni hi mishpacha acheret sheyyatzta miggad, ki min hassetam hayu bechol shevet anafim acherim levad meotam shennivnet mehem hammishpacha vehayu nikraim al achehem, velifamim yigdal heanaf hahu vetikkare hammishpacha al shemo. ella shemmatzati bappesikta veze leshonam: azni ze etzbon, shenneemar befarashat vayyiggash (Bereshit 46:16) milleshon atzet veheezin, ad kan. kefi ze hu hashshem atzmo veen hakkatuv makpid al shinnuy hashshem kesheyyihye bemashmao shem harishon, verashi zichrono livracha ruach hakkodesh hofia bo vechivven el divre chazal.
Vaydabber vegomer lemor. perush "lemor" lihoshua vehazzekenim, ki hu hammanchil et haaretz, veen lefaresh "lemor" leyisrael, ki tevat "laelle" sheamar besamuch tachchish ze.

Bene yissashchar vegomer. lema shekkadam lanu ki yissashchar hu ben tora, ramza hattora beshem ze shel yissashchar ki davka ze yeshno lesachar, vechol chutz mimmennu ma yitron laadam bechol amalo, vehu ma sheamru bivrachot beferek tefillat hashshachar (berachot koach:) shetztzarich levarech bitziato mibbet hammidrash "mode ani lefanecha vechulei ani amel vehem amelim, ani amel umekabbel sachar vehem amelim veenam mekabbelim sachar" vechulei ad kan. vehattaam ki lo yaamod kinyan hammedumme, vahagam sheyyaamod hevel hu. od yirmoz ki kol ma sheyyesh baolam hu sachar lo, ki chol ma shebbara Adonai lo berao ella bishvilo, kemo sheddarshu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 1:1) befarashat bereshit vegomer bishvil tora vechulei bara shamayim vaaretz. od yirmoz lema sheamru zichronam livracha (Uktzin 3,12) atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehanechil lechol tzaddik shelosh meot vaasara olamot, vehu amro yesh sachar.

Veamro letola vegomer, ramaz hakkatuv tenae hassagat hattora bishmot mishpechot yissashchar, vehem arbaim ushemona, keamram (avot 6,5) bammishna shehattora niknet bearbaim ushemona devarim. hinne mashmaut tola yaggid shene peratim: 1, yasim atzmo keadin ze, keamram zichronam livracha (moed katan 16:) al david shennikra "adino haetzni" (Shmuel 2 23:8). 2, sheyyitassek befiv ketola ze shekkochah befiha, ki laamal pe nivra haadam. ushene devarim ellu kollim kol anfe haanava vechol anfe hallimmud hammenuyim bearbaim ushemone maalot hannizkarim.

Veamro lefuvva mishpachat happuni – yesh lehair lamma hosif ot sheenah nimnet meotiyyot hashshem, shehaya lo lomar mishpachat happuvvi? ella ramaz lishar maalot hammenuyim sham baarbaim ushemona (avot 6:5) shehem miut sicha, miut sechok ushear haanafim haddomim leellu. vehu amro lefuvva mishpachat happuni, perush "puvva" hu leshon pe, vehosif lo ot vav shehu sod etz chayyim shehu osek bah yeter al shear happiyyot. gam ramaz bismichut ot havvav leot hei lomar sod chibbur hammiddot beemtzaut esek hattora. veamro mishpachat happuni, perush, shetztzarich lefannoto mimmotarot hammurgashot gam mehassechok umiddevarim betelim, ki hem monim kiyyum hattora baadam. umatzati lachaside yisrael shekkatvu (Alshich al Shemot 28:31) ki pe shel lomde tora dino kichli sharet asher yeshartu bam bakkodesh, ki en kedushsha kikdushshat hattora, velaze asur ledabber bo afillu divre chol hagam sheen bahem devarim haasurim. vehu ma sheramaz bemaamar lefuvva shehu pe heamel battora shebbo shochen chatzi shemo yitbarach, mishpachat happuni perush, tzarich lefannot mippiv kol chutz mehagot battora, uvaze nichlalim chelek echad mehaarbaim ushemone maalot shehem bemiut sicha, bemiut sechok, bemiut taanug vechaddome lahem shebbaanaf hammotarot.

Veamro leyashuv – yirmoz shetztzarich leharebot bishiva velo derech aray, gam tzarich lehityashshev bechol perat uferat mehattora ad sheyyaamod al ikkaro kammitztarech beomek halacha ki hu ze ikkar hattora, uvaze nichlalim chelek echad mehaarbaim ushemone maalot shehem beyishshuv, umityashshev libbo betalmudo, shoel umeshiv, hammechavven et shemuato vechulei, gam ma shemmanu sham shemiat haozen, arichat sefatayim, binat hallev vechulei, vechaddome laze shebbaanaf havanat hassichliyyot.

Veamro leshimron mishpachat hashshimroni – yirmoz letosefet hashshemira hammitchayyev asot ben tora yeter al hehamon, keamram zichronam livracha (yoma 86.): hechi dami chillul hashshem? amar rav: kegon ana deshakilna bisra vela yahivna deme lealtar, ad kan. mizze yakkish kamma tzarich lehishtammer ben tora bechol perate hammitzvot. veamru zichronam livracha (chovat hallevavot sear hatteshuva 85) ki chasidim harishonim hayu shomrim chamishshim shaare hetter leval yikkashlu beshaar haissur, vehu amro "leshimron mishpachat hashshimroni".

Veamro elle mishpechot yissashchar lifkudehem – perush pekudehem, pekida letov, uma hi happekida? peresh hakkatuv veamar arbaa veshishshim elef ushelosh meot. kan ramaz hassaga bishne devarim: haechad, shebbaolam hazze naasim merkava lashshechina, vehu ma sheramaz bemaamar arbaa veshishshim, vehu bechinat nekudda achat, hare 65 shehu mispar 65, veamar beseder ze lomar ki beemtzaut hallamdan titmattek bechinat haddin shecheshbono 64 vetihye nitkenet hashshechina bemisparah 65, keamram zichronam livracha besefer hazzohar (chelek 2 9.) befasuk "vehaem rovetzet al haefrochim" vegomer (Devarim 22:6), vehassaga sheniyya hi laolam habba, karamuz bishmo shelosh meot veeser olamot, vehu ma sheramaz bemaamar elef ushelosh meot.

Vekodem shennaamod al hakkavvana, air bemaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi (Uktzin 3,12) sheamar: atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehanechil vechulei shelosh meot veeser olamot, umochiach meamro (Mishlei 8:21) "lehanechil ohavay yesh". kashe lidvarav zichrono livracha, im lemispar yechavven hakkatuv lamma hikdim hakkatuv mispar haeser lemispar hammeot, shehaya lo lomar "lehanechil ohavay shay"? veshamati mippi harishonim taam arev, ki mispar ze yirmoz learba olamot kayyadua: atzilut, beria, yetzira, asiyya, vechol echad kalul meeser. umaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi ba lelammed ki hatztzaddikim yitannegu al rov shalom baolam haelyon bearba olamot, aval en hassagatam bechullam shava, ella bishlosha yassigu kol hahadragot sheyyeshnam bahem, vehem bemispar shelosh meot, aval baolam haelyon shehu olam haatzilut lo yuchelu lehassig kol tzaddik ki im chelek measara shebbah, shehi gam ken asara bifratam kannizkar shekkol echad kelula meeser. veyesh lecha ladaat ki haeser hammussag meolam haelyon gadol umehullal meod lemala mikkol hashshelosh meot, velaze hikdim hakkatuv haeser lammeot veamar "lehanechil vegomer yesh". veal pi haddevarim yirmoz beamro elef yechavven lachelek hakkatan haramuz beYod, veyiched lo mispar ze shel elef keamram zichronam livracha shekkol eser kelula meeser veeser meeser, hare shennekudda achat titkanne leelef. veamro "ushelosh meot" kifshatah, vehu ma sheramuz bishmo shel yissashchar – "yesh sachar".

rashi: Lezerach. hu tzochar, leshon tzohar, aval mishpachat ohad botla, vechen chamesh mishevet binyamin, shehare baasara vanim yarad lemitzrayim vechan lo mana ella chamisha, vechen etzbon legad, hare sheva mishpachot (tanchuma); umatzati vetalmud yerushalmi shekkeshemmet aharon nistalleku anene chavod, uvau hakkenaanim lehillachem beyisrael, venatenu lev lachazor lemitzrayim, vechazeru laachorehem shemone massaot — mehor hahar lemosera — shenneemar "uvene yisrael naseu mibbeerot bene yaakan mosera sham met aharon" (Devarim 10), vahalo vehor hahar met umimmosera ad hor hahar shemone massaot yesh lemafrea? ella shechazeru laachorehem veradefu vene levi acharehem lehachaziram veharegu mehem sheva mishpachot, umibbene levi nafelu arba mishpachot: mishpachat shimi veuzzieli, umibbene yitzhar lo nimnu kan ella mishpachat hakkorchi, vehareviit lo yadati ma hi (Talmud Yerushalmi Sota 1); verabbi tanchuma darash shemmetu bammaggefa bidvar bilam, aval lefi hachissaron shechasar mishevet shimon beminyan ze mimminyan harishon shebbemidbar sinay, nire shekkol 24 elef nafelu mishivto shel shimon:
ohc: Leshaul mishpachat vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 21,3) amru veze leshonam: amar rabbi yochanan chamishsha shemot nikreu lo: zimri vegomer shaul ben hakkenaanit vegomer, vekashe ledivre hammidrash sheshshaul haamur kan hu zimri, lamma meyaches Adonai shemo al mishpachto hammitkannet alav, vahalo amru zichronam livracha (yoma lach.) bappasuk "veshem reshaim yirkav" dela massekinan bishmayyhu, ad kan, veen tzarich lomar lehachetimo bishmo yitbarach. ulefi echad mehadderachim shepperashnu bappasuk (Bamidbar 25:14) "asher hukka et hammidyanit" shello hukka ella bihyotah immah velo achar kach, hu ma shehitzdik Adonai bemaamaro kan shehechtim shemo alav. vechen mashma gam ken middivrehem zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 21:3) sheamru veze leshonam: shaul – shehishil atzmo laavera, veyadua hu din hasheala shechozeret beenah.

rashi: Rigzu. chirdu millifne hakkadosh baruch hu, veal techetau:
Imru vilvavchem al mishkavchem. hashivu al levavchem shehizhir hakkadosh baruch hu al kach:
targum: Zeu mineh vela techetun imre vautechon vefumechon veshelatchon bilvavchon vetzalu al shivuyechon veidkaru yom mituta lealmin:

ohc: Uverashe chadshechem. amar bechinnuy "chadshechem" lefi shekkiddush hachodesh taluy bevet din shel matta.

rashi: Al pi haggoral. haggoral haya medabber, kemo shepperashti, maggid shennitchalleka veruach hakkodesh {lechach neemar (Yehoshua 19) "al pi Adonai"}:
ohc: Ben rav limat. bemassechet bava batra (daf 122.) amru veze leshonam: ibbaya lehu, eretz yisrael lishvatim ippelug o lekarkaf gavre ippelug? ta shema "ben rav limat". veod tanya: atida eretz yisrael shettechalek lishlosha asar shevatim, shebbattechilla lo nechleka ella lishnem asar vechulei, velo nitchalleka ella bechesef shenneemar "ben rav limat". amar rabbi yehuda: sea bihuda shave chamesh sea baggalil, ad kan. vechatav rashbam sham veze leshono: ta shema "ben rav" vegomer, sheyyikkach kol shevet ma sheyyitten lo haggoral, ben shehaya maggia lo chelek merubbe kegon shevet shehaya lo anashim meat, ben shehaya lo chelek muat kegon shehayu lo anashim merubbim vechulei, dechol hashshevatim cholkin beshave vechulei, ad kan. vekashe bedivre haggemara, lamma mefashshet mehakkatuv kevan sheen lo hechreach mimmennu, shehare babberayta shemmevi mefarsho lekarov lirushalayim verachok mimmenna, karov korehu rav, rachok meat, lefi sheshshave yoter.

Veod nirim divre hashshas sotrim sofam litchillatam, ki meamro "ta shema ben rav" vegomer megalle dato shessover shennitchalleka beshave lashshevatim, umeamro "veod tanya" lo mashma ken, shehare mefaresh amro "ben rav" vegomer lerichuk makom vekeruv makom. umikkoach ze muchrachim anu lomar desover hattalmud ki tanna daatida eretz yisrael sover shennitchalleka eretz yisrael lashshevatim behashevaa, velaze heir hashshas bemaamar "ta shema 'ben rav limat" lomar desover kedivre habbarayta shennitchalleka lashshevatim beshave. veen devarim ellu tzodkim, shehare im nefaresh "ben rav limat" ben shevet shennotel rav lenotel meat leshiur anashav, minnayin lanu lomar richuk makom vekeruv makom, vechen lehefech im nefaresh lerichuk makom vechulei minnayin lomar shennechleka vechulei?

Veod, im nomar shennechleka beshave lashshevatim, im ken naamid machloket rabbi yonatan verabbi yoshiyya bachalukkat kol shevet veshevet bifne atzmo, lemar leyotze mitzrayim ulemar levae haaretz. kefi ze ma maksha haggemara (bava batra 118.) veze leshonah: bishlama leman deamar leyotze mitzrayim hayeynu deka tzavvchan bene yosef, dichtiv (Yehoshua 17:14) "vaydabberu bene yosef", ella leman deamar levae haaretz may ka tzavvche? kulehu shakul litfalim, ad kan. en ani roe kushya, kevan shellechol hassevarot natlu bene yosef beshave im hashshevatim, vetaanat bene yosef hu shehem rabbim mikkol hashshevatim, uven lehaomer leyotze mitzrayim uven lehaomer levae haaretz machloktam hi bechilluk hashshevet atzmo. ella vadday deven lerabbi yonatan ben lerabbi yoshiyya lo nitchalleka haaretz behashevaa lashshevatim, veen lehaamid tanna divrayta hefech shenehem. veod, im nomar shennitchalleka lashshevatim beshave, yoter haya lo litzok shevet yehuda, shehare kefi mispar bae haaretz yesh bemispar yehuda shivim veshishsha elef vachamesh meot, umispar menashshe veefrayim yachad shemonim vachamishsha elef umatayim, nimtza sheen yeterim shenehem mihuda ella shemona alafim usheva meot, venatlu bechiflayim, shehare hem natlu shene chalakim vihuda chelek echad, kemo shemmevoar sham shello nitchalleka ella lishnem asar shevatim levad millevi shello natal chelek baaretz.

Ella hannachon beenay ki lo ala al daat haggemara lomar shennitchalleka lashshevatim beshave kedivre rashbam, uferush devarav sheamar ta shema ben rav limat – mimmashmaut hakkatuv mochiach shehachilluk haya lashshevatim, mimma shehizkir baggoral "ben rav limat", hare shehachalukka shehayta al pi haggoral haya bo chelek rav vechelek muat. veim tomar lekarkaf degavre lo yutzdak leamer "ben rav limat", uferush rav umeat hu ben shevet sheyyesh lo kefi anashav harebe uven shevet sheyyesh lo kefi anashav muat – hakkol yihye al pi haggoral leinyan hammakom sheyyitlu bo chelkehem. veamro veod tanya atida eretz yisrael vechulei – yirtze lehavi haddavar beyoter beur, lefi sheyyesh levaal haddin lachlok velomar sheen lehochiach mippasuk "ben rav limat" ella lomar shello nitchalleka lekarkaf degavre, aval adayin yesh lehistappek im lemishpachot o lishvatim. laze amar" veod tanya atida eretz yisrael vechulei nitchalleka lishnem asar shevatim. nimtzenu omrim ki perush "ben rav limat" lechol hassevarot en nishma mimmennu sheyyachleku hashshevatim beshave, velo chalku ella kefi shiur happekudim, uchedivre tanna shel sifre sheheveti befasuk "ish lefi fekudav".

rashi: Hifla. hivdil:
targum: Vidaun arum parish Adonai zakkaa leh Adonai yekabbel tzeloteh dedavid bemikre levateh:

ohc: Uveyom hashshabbat shene chevasim vegomer. taam shemmusaf shabbat hu muat mikkol musefe rosh chodesh umusefe yom tov vehammoadim, hu sod lechem mishne, velaze musafav shene kevasim al shene kivse tamid, vesod hashsheviiyyot ramuz bayyom atzmo ki hu shevii, ma sheen hashsheviiyyut mesuyyam lo berosh chodesh velo bishar yamim tovim, vahagam sheyyesh shevii shel pesach, en hashsheviiyyut kavua bo keyom hashshabbat, vehaven:

rashi: Vayhi achare hammaggefa vegomer'. mashal leroe shennichnesu zeevim letoch edro veharegu vahen vehu mone otan leda minyan hannotarot; davar acher — kesheyyatzeu mimmitzrayim venimseru lemoshe nimseru lo beminyan, achshav shekkarav lamut ulehachazir tzono machaziran beminyan (tanchuma):
ohc: Vayhi achare hammaggefa vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma asa techillat parasha beemtza hakkatuv. ulefi ma shekkatavti lemala yesh taam nachon, shennitkavven baze lomar ki beemtzaut mitzvat "tzaror" vegomer kederech shepperashnu tikkenu machshevet avoda zara vehittu atzmam latteva haelohi, uvaze "vayhi achare hammaggefa" – perush nistalleka hammaggefa shehayta beyisrael beemtzaut tikkun ze asher tzivva Adonai asot. velaze hitchil happarasha beemtza hakkatuv, lomar ki maamar "achare hammaggefa" mekushshar im ma shellemala mimmennu. vetaam shello asao pasuk bifne atzmo, nitkavven gam ken lekashro lematta sheachar hammaggefa amar Adonai vegomer "seu" vegomer, nimtzeta omer ki maamar "vayhi achare hammaggefa" meshammesh lemala lehaggid inyan echad, ulematta lehaggid inyan acher.

Od nire latet taam shehitchil happarasha meemtza hakkatuv, al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni tehillim tasheag) sheamru veze leshonam: "vayhi achare hammaggefa seu et rosh" vegomer, ze hu sheamar hakkatuv "im amarti mata ragli" vegomer, beshaa shekkibbelu yisrael hattora nitkanneu ummot haolam vechulei, amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: haviu li sefer yochasin shellachem vechulei, keshebbau lashshittim kilkelu vechulei, amru haummot: haatara shehayta beyadam batla, shavim hem lanu, zekafan Adonai shennagaf kol mi shennitkalkel veheemidan al taharatam, ad kan. lefi ze yesh taam bahafesaka beemtza happasuk, lehair shehammaamar kashur gam im ma shelmala beinyan raot asher garmu midyan al devar peor veal devar kazbi vegomer. vegam vayhi achare hammaggefa perush leshon tzaar, vehu ma sheramaz bappasuk "mata ragli" shehayu ummot haolam mezalzelim bahem shennittela haatara shehayta beyadam. vezilzul ze lo nechlat miyyisrael keshennistalleka hammaggefa mehem, ad shemmenaam venimtzeu kol echad makkir avotav ad hashshevet, az nasu rosh. vehu amro vayhi leshon tzaar gam achare hammaggefa, velaze "vayyomer Adonai vegomer seu", velo hechlit lehafesik laasoto pasuk bifne atzmo veervo im ma shelmatta mimmennu, lomar ki bishvil ma sheramuz betevat "vayhi" shehu zilzul haummot hu sheamar Adonai "seu" vegomer:

Od yesh latet taam shehitchil happarasha meemtza hakkatuv al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 21,7) sheamru veze leshonam: kesheyyatzu yisrael mimmitzrayim venimseru lemoshe nimseru beminyan, keshekkarav lamut hechziram beminyan, ad kan. vehu ma shennitkavven behatechalat happarasha vayyomer Adonai el moshe vegomer, lomar ki belo taam "achare hammaggefa" yesh taam beminyan ze kede lehacheziram beminyan kaamur, ella shehayta gam ken sibba acheret shehi "achare hammaggefa", venimtzeu shete sibbot hamminyan nirmazot beemtzaut hatechalat parasha beemtza hakkatuv.

rashi: Kaasher neesaf aharon achicha. mikkan shennitavva moshe lemitato shel aharon (sham); daa — en atta tov mimmennu, "al asher lo kiddashtem" (devarim lev, na), ha im kiddashtem oti adayin lo higgia zemanchem lehippater (sham); bechol makom shekkatav mitatam katav surchanam, lefi shennigzera gezera al dor hammidbar lamut bammidbar beavon shello heeminu, lechach bikkesh moshe sheyyikkatev surchano, shello yomru af hu min hammamrim haya, mashal lishte nashim shellokot bevet din, achat kilkela veachat ochla fagge sheviit vechu', af kan bechol makom shehizkir mitatan hizkir surchanan, lehodia shello hayeta vahem ella zo bilvad (Yoma 86):
ohc: Veraita otah. velo hispik ma shekkevar amar "uree et haaretz", al derech amram zichronam livracha (sifre chelek 1 136) sheherahu Adonai reiyya nissit ma sheen koach beshiur ayin tivit lirot beor hashshemesh, zulat baor hagganuz kayyadua. velaze hivticho veamar lo veraita otah, ki yair lefanav or hachayyim. uchemo chen timtza sheamar hakkatuv (Devarim 34:1) "vayyarehu Adonai" vegomer lehair al haamur.

Gam atta kaasher vegomer. yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni resh parashat mase) sheamru sheamar aharon lemoshe: illu haya yodea ken haya rotze baddavar mikkodem lachen, vehu amro gam atta samuch lemaamar veneesafta, lomar shello yihye nirta mehaasifa, shemmavticho sheggam hu yachpotz veyirtze leasef kesheyyire arevut hammussag bishat mita, veze lecha haot "kaasher neesaf aharon achicha", shehu amar lecha sheim haya yodea vechulei, hare sheggam hachefetz veharatzon yaskimu leasef. od yirtze lehairo bammitzva hammuttelet al hatztzaddikim laasot bishat mita, vehu sheyyatzdik alav et haddin veyachpotz bigzerat melech shettitkayyem, vehu amro veneesafta vegomer gam atta, perush afillu atta taskim leasef, kederech amro (tehillim 31:6) "beyadcha afkid".

Veamro kaasher neesaf aharon vegomer, perush al derech amram zichronam livracha (yalkut sham) sheamar lo moshe leaharon: "aharon achi, mekubbal alecha lamut?" amar lo: "hen". amar lo: "naale lahar", miyyad alu vechulei, ad kan. vehu ma sheramaz bemaamar kaasher neesaf aharon, perush, shehiskim gam hu al haasifa. vetaam haddavar sheose Adonai keseder ze, lefi sheeno chafetz littol nefesh hatztzaddik ella birtzono lerov chibbat yedidav, gam shebbaze yishlemu haosher hashshalem, kaamur (Devarim 6:5) "uvechol nafshecha".

rashi: Lamma yiggara shem avinu. anu bimkom ben omedot, veim en hannekevot chashuvot zera, tityabbem immenu leyavam (bava batra kayit):
Ki en lo ben. ha im haya lo ven, lo hayu toveot kelum, maggid shechachmaniyyot hayu (sham):
ohc: Lamma yiggara. perush, al pi ma sheamru bammishna beferek yesh nochalin (bava batra 116) veze leshonam: benot tzelafchad natlu shelosha chalakim benachala – chelek avihem, vechelko im echav benichse chefer, veshehaya bechor vechulei ad kan. vehu amro lamma yiggara vegomer keneged chelek tzelafchad, tena lanu achuzza betoch ache avinu perush, chelek tzelafchad shennogea lo toch echav benichse chefer shehaya miyyotze mitzrayim, vechelek habbechora kalul hu bemaamar "betoch ache" vegomer. vederech ze eno ella leman deamar shehaaretz nitchalleka leyotze mitzrayim, aval leman deamar levaeha nitchalleka lo natlu chelko shel tzelafchad atzmo. veyitbaer hakkatuv bederech acher, al derech ma sheamru sham (bava batra 118) veze leshonam: amar leh rav pappa leabbaye, bishlama leman deamar leyotze mitzrayim nitchalleka vechulei, hayeynu dichtiv "chavle menashshe asara" – shitta deshitta batte avot vearbea didhu, perush: echad chelek tzelafchad, 2 chelko bechefer, 3 bechorato pi shenayim, 4 chelko birushshat echav. ella leman deamar levae haaretz vechulei, umetaretz: tere ache abba havo leh, ad kan. meatta afilu lisvarat man deamar levaeha nitchalleka, natlu habbanot shete yerushshot – yerushshat tzelafchad deaviv pi shenayim virushshat shene echav shemmetu. laze amru lamma yiggara vegomer keneged yerushshat chefer shennogaat litzlafchad bachazara, tena lanu vegomer keneged yerushshat haachim shemmetu shennogaat litzlafchad gam ken mitztzad hachazara.

Od yitbaer hakkatuv lishte hassevarot behair amro "lamma yiggara shem avinu", shehaya lo lomar "lamma tiggara nachalat avinu". od, lamma chazru lomar ki en lo achar shekkevar amru "uvanim lo hayu lo"? veyitbaer hakkatuv al pi divrehem zichronam livracha bemassechet bava batra (119.) veze leshonam: tana, benot tzelafchad vechulei chachmaniyyot hen shellefi shaa dibberu, deamar rabbi shemuel melammed shehaya moshe yoshev vedoresh befarashat yevamin shenneemar "ki yeshvu achim" vegomer, amru lo: im keven anu ten lanu nachala, veim lo – tityabbem immenu ad kan. vehu ma sheamar hakkatuv kan lamma yiggara shem avinu, perush, zo hi taanat yibbum lehakim shem hammet. velaze dikdeku bilshonam "lamma yiggara shem avinu mittoch mishpachto", vehaggeraon hu "ki en lo ben", vaAdonai tzivva "ki yeshvu achim vegomer uven en lo vegomer yevamah yavo aleha" vegomer. ma tomar shehabbat keven techashev ufoteret, im ken "tena lanu achuzza betoch ache avinu". vahagam derabbi shemuel hikdim bemaamar habbanot taanat hannachala letaanat hayyibbum, lo nitkavven ella lomar shete hatteanot sheamru velo dikdek lomar otam kesidran. vederech ze yeshno ben lisvarat rabbi yoshiyya sheamar haaretz nitchalleka leyotze mitzrayim, ben lisvarat rabbi yonatan sheamar levaeha nitchalleka. lisvarat haomer leyotze mitzrayim shoalim gam chelko shel tzelafchad atzmo ushear chalakim hannogim lo muvanim meatzman, velisvarat haomer levaeha nitchalleka shoalim chalakim hannogim litzlafchad bachazara.

rashi: Navus kamenu. nirmos venirpos oyvenu, leshon "mitboseset bedamayich" (Yechezkel 16:6), "tavus nofet" (Mishlei 27:7), "vehayu chegibborim bosim betit chutzot" (Zecharya 10:5):
targum: Bememrach meikana nenageach bishmach nichbosh kol dekaymin alana:

rashi: Vaydabber moshe el Adonai vegomer'. lehodia shivchan shel tzaddikim, keshenniftarim min haolam mannichim tzorkan, veosekin betzorche tzibbur (sifre):
Lemor. amar lo, hashiveni im atta memanne lahem parnas im lav (sham):
ohc: Vaydabber moshe vegomer lemor. hinne lema shekkadam lanu middivrehem shelleshon dibbur yaggid al maane kashe, kefi ze lamma amar hakkatuv vaydabber moshe lifne Adonai sheen ze mehammusar? od tzarich ladaat amro lemor sheen lah mashmaut bema shellefanenu. veefshar ki moshe ba betaanat mishpat leval yamut, velo lema shemmimmennu ella bishvil yisrael kaasher avaer maamarav, laze amar leshon dibbur. ulefi shebbemaamar moshe haamurim bainyan enam ella divre chibba verachmanut al yisrael, en tachlit haddevarim omed banneemar ella bammitchayyev mehammaamar, shehu meniat hammita mimmennu kaasher avaer, vehu amro lemor.

rashi: Vehayeta lo. veriti zot:

Berit kehunnat olam. sheaf al pi shekkevar nittena chehunna lezaro shel aharon, lo nittena ella leaharon ulevanav shennimshechu immo uletoledotehen sheyyolidu achar hamshachatan, aval pinechas shennolad kodem lachen velo nimshach lo va lichlal kehunna ad kan; vechen shaninu vizvachim (Daf 101) lo nitkahen pinechas ad sheharago lezimri:
Lelohav. bishvil elohav, kemo "hamkanne atta li" (Bamidbar 11), "vekinneti letziyyon" (Zecharya 8) — bishvil tziyyon:
ohc: Tachat asher vegomer vaychapper vegomer. natan taam lema shebbachar lo yah lezakkot hakkehunna lefinchas betorat mattana meAdonai, velo mikkoach aviv, amar tachat asher kinne lelohav – hu asa lelohav vechash al kevodo, gam elohav yerommehu been tzorech lo lehanot bikaro mikar aviv. ucheneged ma sheamar shettihye lo shalom vegam tihye lezaro vegomer, amar vaychapper al bene yisrael – perush, sheasa shalom ben yisrael uven avihem shebbashshamayim, vehinniach leyisrael mechamat melech malache mavet, laze yihye lo berit hashshalom mehem. ucheshem shehahatava asher hetiv bechapparat bene yisrael hi hatava nimshechet, shekkol dor vador habba ba mikkoach harishonim asher kipper alehem, velaze kemo chen tihye nimshechet hatavato gam ken, vehayta lo ulezaro acharav berit kehunnat olam.

Uvederech remez yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 21,3?) sheamru pinchas hu eliyyahu asher hu atid levasser am bene yisrael baggalut haacharon, vechan hodia hakkatuv bamme zacha lemaala zo lehashiv lev banim al avot, veamru zichronam livracha (eduyyot 88 47) en eliyyahu ba ella leharebot shalom baolam, vehu amro pinchas vegomer heshiv vegomer bekano vegomer, kafal lomar shete kenaot lirmoz lakkina shekkinne bizman ze velakkina shekkinne paam sheniyya bime achav, keamro (Melachim 1 19:14) "kanno kinneti laAdonai", gam sham kafal lomar "kanno kinneti" lirmoz lishte kenaot, achat bime moshe veachat bime achav.

Lachen amar hinni noten lo et beriti shalom, shehu habberit shekkarat im haavot latet lahem asara amamin, veze yikkare berit shalom ki az yihye shalom bechol haolam, dichtiv (yeshaya 11:7): "ufara vadov tirena vegomer lo yareu velo yashchitu: vegomer. berit ze yihye lo ki hu ze asher yaase et haddavar hazze veheshiv lev banim al avot vegomer, dichtiv (Malachi 3:23) "hinne anochi sholeach lachem et eliyya" vegomer. velaze dikdek lomar hinni noten lo bifratut velo shittef immo zaro, veachar kach amar berit hakkehunna: "vehayta lo ulezaro acharav berit kehunnat olam". vegamar omer tachat perush shene yiudim ellu hem keneged shene devarim sheasa: berit shalom tachat asher kinne lelohav, kan ramaz bema shekkinne bime achav al sheazvu elohim vehayu ovde avoda zara, vehu ma sheddikdek lomar lelohav shennitkanne al avoda zara shealeha neemar (Devarim 6:15) "ki el kanna" vegomer ad sheamru kol haam (Melachim 1 18:39) "Adonai hu haelohim" vegomer. laze gam ken hu yevasser bayyom hahu asher yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad, shehu gam ken sod "Adonai hu haelohim".

Veamro vaychapper vegomer, hu keneged yiud "vehayta lo vegomer berit kehunnat", ki ze hu lo chelek asher kipper al bene yisrael, kemo chen yihye tamid mechapper alehem, al derech amro (Vayikra 4:20) "vechipper alav hakkohen".

rashi: Et beriti shalom. shettehe lo livrit shalom, keadam hammachazik tova vechannot lemi sheose immo tova, af kan peresh lo hakkabbah shelomotav:
ohc: Lachen emor. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar "lachen" achar sheomer besamuch "tachat asher kinne" shehu gam ken mashmaut maamar "lachen", uvehechreach lomar shehu leshon shevua keamram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 6,4) en "lachen" ella shevua, dichtiv (Shmuel 1 3:14) "lachen nishbati levet eli". vaadayin tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lishvua. velaze yesh lomar ki hutzrach lishvua lechazzek berit hashshalom, hagam shello yihyu banav reuyim ledavar ze yekayyem Adonai et hashshevua.

Od yitbaer hakkatuv al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (zevachim ka:) sheamru ki kodem maase zimri lo nitkahen pinchas, lefi shehaya matzuy velo nimshach, veachar sheasa kinato hayta lo hakkehuna. vehinne yesh beofen ze shene derachim: echad hu derech mechila, vehashsheni derech mattana. derech mechila hu sheyyimchol lo Adonai hakkenas shekkenaso shello nimshach bizman meshichat hakkohanim, vederech mattana hu sheyyitten lo hakkehunna mechadash kederech shennittena leaharon, hagam sheaviv veechav lo hayu kohanim. uchefi haddin yesh hefresh ben im yihye haddavar derech mechila lederech netina: derech mechila enah tzericha kinyan, vederech mattana tzericha kinyan, vechol od shello kanu miyyado lo zacha hamekabbel bammattana ella bema shekkevar higgio.

Od yesh bederech mattana shete raot ma sheen ken im tihye derech mechila, ki bederech mechila im yimchol lo al hakkenas veyachzor lichhunnat aharon, af hu batlu hammeorrim al kehunnato kederech shebbatlu al kehunnat aharon shemmimmennu ba, ma sheen ken bederech mattana sheyyeshnam lammeorrim alav kederech shehayu al aharon battechilla, uma gam shehaya lahem sina immo lesibbat harigat hannasi vechulei, 2, shebbederech mattana yesh makom lomar shehaddavar chiddush veen lecha bo ella chiddusho, ma sheen ken im yihye bederech mechila vechozer lichhunnat aharon shechozer haddavar lesharsho vetzeetzaav kemoto, nimtzet omer ki bishlosha derachim derech hammechila hu hannaot midderech hammattana: 1 sheen tzarich kinyan, 2 sheen lachush lammeorrim, 3 shettihye nimshechet lo uleyotze chalatzav.

Vehinne haadon Adonai nira beenav baruch hu leromem maalat pinchas laasot haddavar bederech mattana, sheyyihye kohen mitztziddo velo mitztzad heanaf shebba mimmennu letiferet lo, vehu amro hinni noten lo bederech mattana. vetikken elohe olam kol hashshelosha devarim sheyyesh bahem pikpuk kesheyyihye derech mattana kemo sheamarnu: keneged ma sheamarnu mattana tzericha kinyan amar "lachen" leshon shevua, ucheneged chashash hameorrim amar hinni noten lo et beriti shalom, ucheneged michush sheen haddavar ella lefinchas vechiddush hu amar vehayta lo ulezaro acharav vegomer, shemmattana zo nitkayyema beyado bishvua mippi habbore shettihye lo leshalom ulezaro acharav kehunnat olam. uchevar hairoticha bishnayim uvishlosha mekomot shehakkehunna hi nefesh hannikret ken bimkom hanneshamot, vehivtiach Adonai et pinchas ki yishtalshel bezaro anaf ze hakkadosh hannikra kehunna, vehu sod amro "kehunnat olam".

rashi: Larav tarbe nachalato. leshevet shehaya merubbe beuchlusin natenu chelek rav, veaf al pi shelo hayu hachalakim shavim, shehare hakkol lefi ribbuy hashevet chaleku hachalakim, lo asu ella aye goral, vehaggoral haya al pi ruach hakkodesh, kemo shemmeforash bevava vatra (Daf 122): elazar hakkohen haya melubbash beurim vetummim veomer beruach hakkodesh im shevet peloni ole, techum peloni ole immo, vehashevatim hayu chetuvim bishnem asar petakin veyb gevulin beyb petakin, uvelalum bakkalpi, vehannasi machnis yado letocho venotel shenayim petakin, ole veyado petek shel shem shivto ufetek shel gevul hamforash lo, vehaggoral atzmo haya tzoveach veomer ani haggoral aliti ligvul peloni leshevet peloni, shenneemar "al pi haggoral", velo nitchalleka haaretz bemidda, lefi sheyyesh gevul meshubbach mechavero, ella veshuma, bet kor ra keneged bet sea tov, hakkol lefi haddamim:
ohc: Larav tarbe vegomer. amru bemassechet bava batra (4 117:) veze leshonam: amar leh rav pappa leabbaye, bishlama leman deamar leyotze mitzrayim, hayeynu dichtiv "larav tarbe" vegomer, ella leman deamar levae haaretz, may "larav" vegomer? kashya, ad kan. perush, im hachalukka hi leotam hammenuyim bearvot moav, ma makom lomar "larav" vegomer? hinne kushya zo enah meeze diyyuk, rak shennuchal lomar lo natan dato alav, shehare mikra male dibber hakkatuv. veod, en ellu divre amora lidchotan ella divre rabbi yonatan shehu tanna. ulefi ma shekkadam lanu mikkelale hattalmud, shekkol sheyyomar haggemara "kashya" hi omedet leterutz, ella shello nizdammen lahem terutz.

Venire lefi ma shepperashti bema sheamar "bemispar shemot" shechozer al hachamishshim vesheva mishpachot, yeduyyak al nachon amro "larav" vegomer, perush sheyyechalleku chamishshim veshiva chalakim, velo chelek kechelek yihye, ella "larav tarbe nachalato". hammashal – mishpacha sheyyesh bah esrim elef tittol bechiflayim mehammishpacha sheyyesh bah asara.

Od nire lefi darko shel Rashi zichrono livracha, ki rabbi yonatan sover shello yittelu chalukka ella otam shehayu bemispar arvot moav. kefi ze ba hakkatuv: leim hayu leechad asara banim bene esrim, uleechad shemona banim – arbaa mibben esrim vearbaa lematta meesrim, uvichnisatan laaretz mi shehayu lo asara bene esrim metu lo arbaa, umi shehayu lo arbaa bishmona lematta meesrim higgiu lichlal esrim bishat hachalukka. laze amar hakkatuv "larav" – perush bizman hammispar "tarbe nachalato" – perush mi shehayu lo asara bene esrim bemispar ze tarbe lo keshiur asara, hagam sheen lo ella shishsha. velamat" bizman hammispar shello hayu lo ella arbaa bene esrim "tamit" latet lo keshiur arbaa, hagam sheyyesh lo shemona bene esrim. veulay sherashi zichrono livracha letaretz kushya zo nitchakkem bemaamaro.

Ish lefi fekudav vegomer. besifre (sifre Bamidbar 132) amru veze leshonam: "lefi fekudav" melammed shello nitchalleka haaretz ella lechol shevet veshevet lefi ma shehu, ad kan. en baze setira lema shepperashti befasuk "bemispar shemot" shennitchalleka lachamishshim vesheva mishpachot. efshar shennitchalleka lashshevatim velammishpachot al ze hadderech: chilleku haaretz lishnem asar chalakim vehachalakim lachamishshim veshiva chalakim, shevet sheyyesh lo shete mishpachot yittol shene chalakim, umi sheyyesh lo arbaa yittol arbaa chalakim, vehachelek yihye kefi hammispar, lemar mispar yotze mitzrayim ulemar mispar arvot moav. veim tomar, kevan shemmechallekim lammishpachot lamma hutzrechu lechallek lashshevatim? hattaam kede sheyyihye kol shevet goralo bifne atzmo, ma shello yihye chen im yechalleku lammishpachot, sheyyachol laasot goral lishne mishpechot shimon im mishpechot zevulun ulehefech, velo yihyu kol shevet veshevet yachad.

Uvemassechet bava batra (4 122.) amru, veze leshonam: ibbaya lehu, eretz yisrael lishvatim ippelig o lekarkaf gavre ippelug? ta shema: "ben rav limat", veod tanya: atida eretz yisrael shettechalek lishlosha asar shevatim, shebbattechilla lo nechleka ella lishnem asar shevatim, ad kan. venelam mehashshas barayta besifre shedderashuha meish lefi fekudav", umistabbera ki tanna dishlosha asar shevatim gam ken derashato meish lefi fekudav" ketanna desifre, veayyen befasuk "ben rav" vegomer:

Od yitbaer ledarko shel rabbi yonatan shessover "laelle techalek haaretz" shehem bae haaretz, vaadayin en ani yodea im davka lehabbaim lichlal esrim o lichlal bae haaretz vaafillu leotam shello higgiu lichlal esrim, talmud lomar "lefi fekudav", ha lamadta ki davka livne esrim, uvaze anu matzdikim divre Rashi shepperesh befasuk "laelle" velo mittaamo.

rashi: Veamarta lahem. azhara levet din (sifre):
Shenayim layyom. kifshuto, veikkaro va lelammed sheyyihyu nishchatin keneged hayyom — tamid shel shachar bammaarav veshel ben haarbayim bemizrachan shel tabbaot (Sifre; Yoma 62):
ohc: Veamarta lahem ze haishshe vegomer. yiched amira acheret, gam amar ze haishshe, leval yachshevu ki ma sheyyetzav Adonai keves echad vegomer lattemidin hu letzad hahistappekut velo leshiur hannigbal bishlilat hayyoter mimmennu vehappachot mimmennu, laze yiched amira lehagebil haddavar veamar "ze haishshe" – ze velo yoter mimmennu "et hakkeves echad vegomer veet hakkeves" vegomer. nimtzeta omer shebbefasuk rishon "tzav et" vegomer nitztauu al hatemadat hakeravat hattemidin, uvefasuk ze nitztauu al shiur hakeravat hattemidin.

rashi: Tzaror. kemo zachor, shamor, leshon hove — alechem leayyev otam:
ohc: Tzaror et hammidyanim vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal tzaror vehikkitem, verabbotenu zichronam livracha hirgishu veamru (Bamidbar Rabba 101) ki nitkavven baze lomar shehagam shetztzivva Adonai (Devarim 20:10) "ki tikrav el ir vegomer lo tashchit et etzah" vegomer, zo umma kalla uvezuya lehashechit et etzah vegomer, ad kan. vetzarich ladaat ma nekama hi zo lemidyan, veadrabba haya lahem lekayyem (Devarim 20:14) "veachalta et shelal oyvecha" shezze hu lahem yoter nekama vedaavon nefesh, vechayyotze baze matzinu bekillot hattora (Vayikra 26:16) "vaachaluhu oyvechem".

Od tzarich ladaat amro ki tzorrim, lamma hutzrach lintinat taam? ulefi divre razal sheamru shebba lomar yashchitu etza vechulei, yesh lanu makom lomar shebba latet taam levittul mitzvat "lo tashchit" vegomer bammakom hazze ki tzorrim. uvattanchuma amru veze leshonam: "tzaror" vegomer lamma, "ki tzorrim" vegomer – mikkan amru habba lehargecha vechulei. uledivre tanchuma ba hakkatuv lehodiacha mishpat habba vechulei, veze derech derash.

Venire lefaresh, behair lamma tzivva Adonai mitzva zo shello bizmannah, ki matzinu sheachar kach hutzrach Adonai letzauot lomar (Bamidbar 31:2) "nekom nikmat bene yisrael meet hammidyanim", ha lamadta ki maamar ze lo haya bizman hannekama.

Achen nitkavven Adonai bemaamar ze letakkanatam shel yisrael, lefi shekkol asher yitom taam chet hattivi hashsholet baadam shello lirtzono, lu yihye shello teamo ella bivchinat hachoshev, kashe hu lehaferido, uchemo sheheerachti bifrat ze befarashat achare mot (Vayikra 18:3) befasuk "kemaase eretz mitzrayim" vegomer. vechol od shello nifrad mehachote taavat haddavar uteshukato elav hu meshullal mehakkappara, uchemo shepperashti befarashat bereshit bema sheamar hakkatuv (Bereshit 4:7) "veelecha teshukato veatta timshal bo". uma shellefanenu am bene yisrael taamu arivat hazzenut, mehem bemaase mehem bemachshava, gam nidbeku bappeor, dichtiv (Bamidbar 25:3): "vayyitztzamed yisrael levaal peor", veamru razal (Bamidbar Rabba 20) shennaasu ketzamid vechulei, ad kan. vechafetz Adonai lerappeotam baatzat Adonai hannechona kede lesallek mealehem hammaggefa, shehalo timtza shehayta hammaggefa beyisrael ad asher safu tammu kol hannitzmadim levaal peor, dichtiv (Devarim 4:3): "ki chol haish asher halach achare vaal peor hishmido Adonai elohecha mikkirbecha". uvehechreach atta lomar ki lo al haesrim vearbaa elef sheamar hakkatuv (Bamidbar 25:9): "vayyihyu hammetim vegomer arbaa" vegomer hu omer, sheellu hayu mishshevet shimon umetu al sheratzu lishloach yad befinchas kemaamaram zichrono livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 20), vehakkatuv omer "asher halach achare vaal peor hishmido" vegomer, ha lamadta shehishmid gam kol hazzonim levad haesrim vearbaa elef. gam mimma sheamar hakkatuv kan "hammukka veyom hammaggefa al devar peor", ze yaggid shemmetu miyyisrael levad otam shemmetu bishvil pinchas sheratzu lishloach bo yad.
